title: Vue Blocks Vite Build Manifest
description: Contract between the Vite build output and the WordPress theme's functions.php opt-in enqueue path. The build writes this file into dist/manifest.json; functions.php reads it when VB_USE_BUNDLED_ASSETS is true.

app.description: Logical alias for the JS entry (assets/js/app.js).

file.description: Path of the emitted JS bundle, relative to the repository root. Must live under dist/.

isEntry.description: Marks the entry JS bundle so functions.php can confirm it is the root of the JS graph.

imports.description: Other logical names whose JS this bundle imports (informational; usually empty for this theme).

css.description: Other logical names whose CSS this bundle emits (informational; usually empty for this theme).

style.description: Logical alias for the CSS entry (style.css).

file.description: Path of the emitted CSS bundle, relative to the repository root. Must live under dist/.

isEntry.description: Marks the entry CSS bundle so functions.php can confirm it is the root of the CSS graph.
